purpose: Reuse the existing foundry to supply genuinely new compact Supa reasoning and preservation data while retaining the primary Titan program and its evidence.

reuse: independent public reconstruction and gold checks
existing_infrastructure.integration: Use additive Supa source/consumer adapters through the qualified owned pipeline after its live cycle. Source preparation in this disjoint directory does not modify the global registry, queue, lock or release controller.
existing_infrastructure.separate_learner_identity: Bind Supa checkpoint/tokenizer/template/runtime independently. Never reuse Titan qualification, token profiles, decoder policy or permits as Supa evidence.

bank_roles.source: Fresh separate own-rights worlds, not historical or core-bank derivatives

required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.observed_gap: Reference opening+sum(changes) is permutation-invariant. Printed order and event count do not establish chronological reasoning.
required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.new_contract_requirement: Specify actual noncommuting state transitions or reads whose outcomes depend on chronological event order. Declare how explicit times/order markers determine order, tie/conflict behavior and valid unknown state. Bound state values and all operations.
controls: A qualified event-order/time intervention changes the answer when order matters.
Physical record relocation preserves the answer when explicit chronological markers are retained.
Necessary-event/value cuts, overwrites and redundant events are measured separately; do not call irrelevant or reset-discarded events reasoning depth.

required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.observed_gap: Reference marker branch is static retrieval and does not establish entity/reference binding.
required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.new_contract_requirement: Specify public identity, aliases, references or ownership changes whose composition resolves the queried entity. Handle missing links, ambiguous references, conflicting claims and invalid cycles explicitly without private marker shortcuts.
controls: Entity/alias/reference swaps alter the answer under the same public query when relevant.
Consistent renaming and irrelevant entity addition preserve semantics.
Necessary reference links are supported by actual interventions, not merely counted mentions.

required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.observed_reusable_checks: Reference handles missing quantities, exhaustive-inventory status, query-local conflict, intact partner pairs and distinct nonzero offsets at CPU-fixture source scope.
required_semantic_repairs_before_generat.new_contract_requirement: Independently parse every public quantity, membership/exhaustiveness claim and arithmetic rule. A private stored number cannot supply an omitted public fact. Do not assume an unlisted inventory item is absent without the exact public closed-world rule.
controls: Missing required quantity/exhaustiveness yields genuinely unsupported gold, not a guessed number.
Relevant quantity and membership changes affect the answer; irrelevant facts/relocation do not.
Symmetric positive/negative offset and intact answerability-pair evidence is recorded.

shared_truth_contract.before_any_case: Freeze bounded public semantics, literal controlled-English grammar, source/generator/parser/oracle hashes, role pools and intended strata. Original reference fixtures remain EXCLUDED and cannot become fresh bank worlds.
shared_truth_contract.parse: Consume the complete instruction/context/query and every record, with exact spans and no ignored tail. Unsupported/malformed/incomplete analysis is METHOD_HOLD, not semantic UNKNOWN.
shared_truth_contract.gold: Store final-answer gold separately from both answer-only and compact-step assistant targets. Commit an independently reconstructed public solution before comparison with author truth.
shared_truth_contract.unanswerable: Establish insufficiency under the actual public rules. Where possible give two compatible public-world completions with different final answers; distinguish conflict, missing evidence, source invalidity and reviewer uncertainty. Intended25% quotas are not gold and cannot be achieved by relabeling answerable cases.
shared_truth_contract.steps: Validate every displayed intermediate value/reference against public facts and transition order. Compact UNKNOWN traces identify the insufficiency and end in UNKNOWN; they do not invent omitted values. Correct final answers cannot excuse a false trace.
shared_truth_contract.horizon: Declare and measure relevant composition/necessary evidence. CHECK depth5/6 strata and generalization floors are subsets of1200 with overlaps/parent counts reported, not extra IID observations.

role_and_source_custody.prospective_ledger: Reserve every role/semantic parent/content group before bodies, solving, target construction or model exposure through actual source/family/global-exclusion anchors. No actual ledger is created by this plan.
role_and_source_custody.partition: Use real structural/scenario/vocabulary/template/wording/numeric-range partitions, not renamed IDs. All partners/views/targets/control descendants preserve parent ancestry and exposure scope; never cross into DEV/CHECK or repurpose spent/excluded material.
role_and_source_custody.fixed_denominators: Preserve all attempted, held, invalid, failed, missing or uncertain slots. No outcome-driven refill, silent subset, padding or target/history truncation.
role_and_source_custody.locked_banks: Root accesses only authorized CHECK/GUARD_CHECK commitments, schema, counts and custody metadata now. Body construction, any quality review and eventual exposure must follow the exact registered custody route; no historical task_BANK or sealed/spent-bank body read occurs here.
role_and_source_custody.guards: Fresh guard content is distinct from replay/core roles. Later source-correct guard enrollment requires the exact frozen-control policy/output evidence; gold correctness alone is not a mastery label and does not establish retention.

every_row_admission: Actual original source-use/rights and complete ancestry/role/exclusion binding
Independent whole-public-prompt reconstruction and committed gold
Complete parent/pair integrity and actual structural/generalization partition checks
Completed eligible nonauthor row reviews and communication evidence with honest exposure/delivery scope
Byte-bound passport coverage surviving final actor-only export
Exact Supa native offline token/template/target/EOS/first-target/causal-shift profiles and immutable release/custody

token_and_target_modes.profile_both_target_modes: Complete answer-only and compact-step sequences using the exact Supa tokenizer/template; valid mode-specific prompts and full histories. Character estimates or Titan profiles do not qualify fit.
token_and_target_modes.mixed_arm: Exactly50%core compact-step targets stratified by family/answerability; all replay answer-only. Pair case membership/order/initialization across methods and seeds under the consumer's registration.
token_and_target_modes.dose: Report actual supervised and processed tokens for both modes. Equal rows, updates and seed lists do not imply equal token/compute dose or a pure process-supervision effect.

implementation_sequence: Review and freeze genuine three-family public semantics plus complete bounded grammar and independent author/public implementations.
Reconcile actual source/family/global-exclusion and reservation/custody interfaces with the existing foundry owner; keep native/registered action flags closed until their real prerequisites.
Run a separately reserved EXCLUDED development-control method with planted defects and full failure accounting; no fixture promotion or CHECK body access.
After gates qualify, freeze the complete7200-world role ledger and construct fresh own-rights worlds in bounded immutable cohorts under the existing pipeline.
Check every public actor, final gold, target variant, control and parent; retain complete row-passport and reviewer coverage rather than sample-based admission.
Profile exact complete Supa sequences and export admitted immutable TRAIN/DEV/replay/guard artifacts with locked CHECK custody commitments.
Provide local handoff metadata to the existing consumer owner. Native M1/training/evaluation/selection/CHECK/deployment remain that owner's separately source-bound actions.
immediate_scope: CPU source/data construction-admission preparation and metadata only through applicable gates; no pretrained model workload, backward, optimizer, training, deployment or historical bank reads.
existing_resource_policy: Reviewed metadata Budget128MiB lifetime peak/RSS,384MiB after-import floor,256MiB reserve,60s cooperative loop,4096samples. Any new tokenizer/constructor method needs its own exact bounded source/runtime evidence; no reset/pruning/GC/cap raise or native permit borrowing.
next_action: Prepare exact independently reviewable genuine order-sensitive state and entity-binding semantics/source adapters, then close real source/registry/role/custody gates before case construction. Preserve reference corrections without copying its exposed fixtures.
